data.description: Operator feedback: the VerifiedBadge (AGNTM-5) placed top-left of AgentCandidateCard overlaps the bot icon + agent name. Rethink placement so it never collides with the name/score (top), HIRED chip (top-right), or REVIEWS hover chip. Likely move to the meta chip row (next to style chip + paid-jobs) or the footer wallet row. Follow-up to AGNTM-5; lands in PR #1 (cleanverse branch).
data.title: Fix A-Pass badge overlap on agent card

data.body: Verified visually in c11 browser + headless screenshot: badge inline in meta row, no overlap on any of the 4 cards; verified (green A-PASS) state confirmed. Unverified (amber) state will validate when the contrast agent lands.

REVIEW (pass): diff is a pure presentational move — VerifiedBadge relocated from absolute top-left into the meta chip row in AgentCandidateCard.tsx; no logic/props change, no other files touched. tsc 0 errors. Visually verified in c11 browser + headless screenshot: no overlap on any of the 4 cards, green A-PASS renders inline. Honesty/zero-regression unaffected (badge still returns null for undefined/unavailable). Approve.
